title: SoundFont Capability Manifest
description: Declares what a single SoundFont (SF2/SF3) can play, so playback can resolve a notated percussion hit to a real sample WITHOUT relying on an assumed ambient kit. One manifest per SoundFont. Three layers: (1) raw capability — every preset and, for percussion banks, the per-key sample that actually exists; (2) semantic resolution — canonical drum identities mapped to the best (kit, key) address in THIS font, with documented fallbacks; (3) known collisions — places where the GM key map lies for this font (e.g. a crash key that lands in a timpani zone). Scores stay authored against portable GM; this manifest owns every font-specific deviation.

id.description: Stable kebab-case identifier, e.g. 'shan-sgm-pro-15'. Used as the lookup key when the app selects a manifest for a loaded font.

file.description: Filename in the audio package's canonical sounds assets.

standard.description: Sound-set standard the bank/program layout follows, e.g. 'GM', 'GM/GS', 'XG'.

generatedFrom.description: How this manifest was produced (e.g. the parser script + SF2 hash), for reproducibility.

banks.description: Which bank numbers (CC0/bank-MSB) carry melodic vs. percussion presets in this font.

melodic.description: Bank numbers that contain pitched/melodic presets.

percussion.description: Bank number reserved for drum kits. 128 in GS-style fonts.

drumKits.description: Every drum-kit preset in the percussion bank, with its complete per-key sample map (the raw capability layer). The presence of a key here is the ground truth used to validate a chosen address at load time.

program.description: Program (patch) number within the percussion bank.

name.description: Kit name as stored in the SF2 preset header.

keyCount.description: Number of mapped keys (informational; equals keys length).

keys.description: MIDI key number → the sample/zone that sounds when that key is struck on this kit.

sample.description: Sample name backing this key (from the SF2 SHDR chunk).

gm.description: GM Level-1 percussion name for this key, when the key falls in the standard GM map (informational, font-independent).

melodicPresets.description: Flat list of every pitched preset (the raw melodic capability). Drives instrument selection and validates a part's chosen (bank, program).

percussionSemantics.description: Layer 2: canonical drum IDENTITIES resolved to the best address in THIS font. A score references a semantic id (e.g. 'crashCymbal'); the resolver picks the entry whose kit matches the part's active kit, else walks `fallback`. This is where font-specific deviations from the naive GM key map live, so scores never hardcode them.

gmKey.description: The portable GM Level-1 key for this identity — what a score writes by default and what plays on any generic GM font.

resolution.description: kit-program (as string) → the concrete address that realizes this identity in that kit.

sample.description: Verified sample name at this (kit, key).

borrowKit.description: If set, send this note on a dedicated channel loaded with THIS kit program instead of the part's main kit (the `drumKit` kit-component override). Used when the part's own kit lacks the sound (e.g. Tam-tam borrowed from the Ethnic kit).

reason.description: Why this address differs from the naive GM key (e.g. 'GM key 49 is a timpani zone in this kit').

fallback.description: Ordered list of other semantic ids to try if no `resolution` entry matches the active kit.

knownCollisions.description: Layer 3: documented places where the GM key map is misleading for this font, so a naive lookup would play the wrong sound. Each entry pairs the wrong result with the workaround already encoded in `percussionSemantics`.

kit.description: Drum-kit program where the collision occurs.

key.description: MIDI key whose GM meaning is broken in this kit.

expectedGm.description: What GM Level-1 says this key should be.

actualSample.description: What this font actually plays at that key.
